heroHeadline: Iran Offers Houthi-Saudi Mediation; Riyadh Investigates Air Defence Failure After 13 Killed
heroSubtitle: Iran has offered to mediate between its Houthi allies and Saudi Arabia amid a sustained Houthi strike campaign on Saudi airports. Saudi Arabia opened an investigation into how its air defences failed to stop the Riyadh airport strike that killed at least 13, while further flight suspensions ground the capital's skies.
